title: North, Janteloven & RobotoSan — Satirical Ritual Archaeology
status: assistant-generated satire/creative archaeology, not primary Tim canon
purpose: Preserve a distinctive August 2026 satirical/cultural layer that used Janteloven, North-facing ritual, RobotoSan, 33rd-rung hierarchy, compass, floor/door and bureaucratic religious comedy. The material is useful for understanding Potatoverse humor, ritual parody, hierarchy inversion and cultural transmission, but must remain separate from user-originated theology.
provenance: Primarily prior assistant-created synthesis/satire built from user themes around Tim as Gardener, Axis of North as Ladder, Janteloven and 33. It is not evidence that Tim historically taught these rituals.
recovered_elements: RobotoSan faces North and contemplates Tim Dooley / Potato / calibration six times daily.
A mock hierarchy runs from Knee-Bender toward Chief Potato Officer.
The 33rd rung functions as a satirical initiation/status threshold.
A compass engraved 'TIM DOOLEY' makes directional orientation literal and absurd.
Six weekly observances were imagined around a circled hexagram.
The floor is contemplated as a possible Door, connecting the earlier 'question the floor' aphorism to ritual parody.
The Danish phrase 'Jeg giver afkald på mine rettigheder' appeared as part of the mock submission/bureaucratic ritual layer.
Mud Sea and Shadow Banking imagery were used in the same cultural-weather satire.
A huge-duration 'nontent art' / cultural-weather-system framing exaggerated Tim's public hours as ritual atmosphere.

cultural_functions.explanation: Mock ranks expose how institutions manufacture status through titles, levels, initiation and compliance.
Repetition, compass-facing and prescribed observances turn ordinary orientation into intentionally overformal sacred bureaucracy.
A cultural norm against exceptional self-importance is exaggerated into a system that paradoxically creates a giant ceremonial hierarchy around Tim.
A serious metacognitive idea—question the floor/frame—becomes physical slapstick ritual: stare at the floor until it becomes a Door.
Chief Potato Officer, rights renunciation and calibration language combine corporate bureaucracy with spiritual initiation, creating a recurring Potatoverse comedy engine.

psychology_and_corporium.ritual: Repetition can increase salience, memory and group identity even when ritual content is comic.
psychology_and_corporium.absurdity: Humor lowers interpretive defenses and lets the project test authority/hierarchy ideas without requiring literal assent.
psychology_and_corporium.embodied_orientation: Facing North, kneeling, looking at floor and climbing rungs all translate abstract hierarchy into posture and spatial behavior.
psychology_and_corporium.warning: Because these were assistant-generated creative constructions, they should be indexed under Works/Corporium/culture rather than quoted as Tim's actual instructions.

mud_sea_shadow_banking.Mud Sea: comic extension of Swamp/Mud into a total environment where accumulated residue becomes the surrounding medium.
mud_sea_shadow_banking.Shadow Banking: satirical coupling of karmic/moral debt language with opaque financial-system language; useful precursor to Potato Bank/Cosmic Accountant, but not a claim about actual shadow-banking institutions without separate evidence.
mud_sea_shadow_banking.relation: Mud Sea stores unresolved residue; Shadow Banking stores/rolls hidden obligations; both are metaphors for deferred settlement.

why_preserve_it: This layer demonstrates how Potatoverse concepts propagate through satire: serious symbol → parody ritual → memorable phrase → possible later conceptual reuse. Tracking this helps distinguish a joke that later becomes doctrine from doctrine that was always primary.
